column2: To recognize competitive practice in home country

• The GMD is entitled to pension provision through the Company’s defined contribution plan for all permanent
employees. The employer’s contribution as a percentage of basic salary is 7.5% and the GMD’s contribution
is 7.5%.
• The participant may opt to remain a member of the Company’s defined benefit plan even upon leaving the
Company.
• The level of contribution is higher than the market rate which provides for 6%.
